name: Türkiye Scholarships
purpose: A premium, modern, minimal, and institutional platform (turkiyescholarships.com) helping prospective international students discover scholarships, universities, and academic pathways in Turkiye, with free personalized guidance toward the right program and application route.
audience: Prospective international students worldwide considering higher education in Turkiye -- across academic pathways, partner universities, and scholarship opportunities -- who need trustworthy, guided information rather than a directory to search alone.
